verdict.rationale: Typesense says it offers built-in RAG and Natural Language Search through LLM integrations ([typesense-docs-42], [typesense-docs-41]), which can produce AI-generated answers grounded in indexed data. Beyond that, the AI angle is external: its Cloud MCP server lets an outside agent read metrics and tune search ([typesense-docs-43]), rather than the product offering insights or suggestions itself. Missing for 10: in-product AI insights or suggestions about the user's data (e.g., dashboard analytics or relevance-tuning recommendations), detailed documentation of the RAG answer flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
